verdict.rationale: Omarchy publishes an official manual that walks through the desktop interface: the keyboard-driven workflow, Omarchy Menu navigation, themes, clipboard and other hotkeys. Install guidance covers writing the ISO to USB and answering five questions, plus manual pages on dual-booting beside Windows and unattended installs, and a VM option to try it first. Community users describe the install as uncomplicated and the best out-of-the-box Linux experience. Missing for 10: evidence of step-by-step tutorial content for the install (beyond summary descriptions), any interactive onboarding or tour for learning the keyboard-only desktop, and independent confirmation that the manual works well for newcomers.
